patterns.what_worked: Production action context identified the exact CVE and initial path; exhaustive repository triage found a second direct declaration and the patch-only NuGet update was applied to both with a scoped attributed commit.
patterns.what_was_hard: The delegated orchestrator lacked required skill tooling, the alert API lacked credentials, package restore was blocked by registry source and TLS constraints, and GitHub permissions prevented both upstream push and fork creation.
patterns.improvisation: Used the public advisory patched floor and direct repository evidence after the alert API could not supply classification or recommended version; preserved the dedicated skill sequence in the parent session.
patterns.recurring_pattern: Dependency remediation can be correct at the manifest level while environment feed configuration and repository permissions prevent build validation and PR delivery.
patterns.skill_gap: The dependency orchestrator should expose its mandatory skill tool in delegated sessions or accept a complete pre-triaged plan without re-invoking unavailable tooling.
patterns.tsg_gap: The source action reported version 8.0.0 while the repository had already moved to 8.0.3 and omitted the patched version; action payloads should include the advisory floor.
patterns.environment_blockers: NuGet.org was disabled by default, the enabled proxy did not serve the package, explicit NuGet.org access failed TLS, Component Detection was unavailable, and GitHub push/fork operations returned 403.

outcome.changes_proposed: Update every direct System.Security.Cryptography.Xml declaration from 8.0.3 to the minimum patched 8.0.4 release.
outcome.escape_hatch_used: parent-session direct skill routing after delegated tooling failure
outcome.full_journey: Production S360 context was fetched for the specified action. The request routed to dependency remediation, but delegated planning failed due missing tool access and unavailable alert credentials. The parent session ran environment, triage, repository-analysis, NuGet, semantic-verification, and component-detection skills. Two direct vulnerable declarations in [repo] were updated to the minimum safe version and committed locally with attribution. Deterministic diff and scope checks passed. Restore/build/test were blocked by registry TLS access, component detection was unavailable, and PR publication was blocked by GitHub permissions.
